items.title: Burnham told to put ‘brake’ on calls for new EU deal – podcast
items.desc: It is a big week for Andy Burnham as two of his big policy priorities enter the spotlight. On Tuesday, the Milburn review of welfare for under-25s is published, which could ignite old Labour tensions over benefit cuts. Then, later this week, Burnham will be in Brussels for the UK-EU summit to discuss a potential new deal. But, as Pippa has signalled, cabinet ministers have told Burnham to put the brake on some of the discussions to ensure the government is not out of step with the public. Is it too little too late? items.title: ‘Loaded with potential’: stage version of TV smash It’s a Sin has the dancefloor at its heart
items.desc: Exclusive: Trailer released for Rambert’s version of Russell T Davies’s show about friendship amid the 80s Aids crisis and the ‘extraordinary freedom’ of clubbing Russell T Davies’s award-winning series It’s a Sin, about young gay friends living through the Aids crisis in 1980s London, is getting a new life as a dance piece , with a trailer released on Monday ahead of an opening at Aviva Studios in Manchester in February. “We had a few approaches, but a lot of people wanted to make it a musical, which made my heart sink slightly,” said Davies. “I always imagined an aria between those two women on the seafront at the end and I thought: ‘Oh, that could be so terrible!’” Dance was different, he said. “It felt so original and so pure.
